gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma per 2021 WHO classification progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: The primary objective of this study is to select the optimal regimen of L19TNF in combination with lomustine, that maximizes effects on clinical parameters and minimizes the probability of moderate to severe adverse events

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study With L19TNF in Combination With Lomustine in Patients With Glioblastoma at Progression or Recurrence

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetics assessment of L19TNF through blood sampling

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The trial aims to collect safety, efficacy, exposure, dose- response, pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic information of the combination of L19TNF and lomustine at different dose levels

role_evidence.quote: Each arm has a different combination of L19TNF (7 μg/kg or 10 μg/kg or 13 μg/kg) and lomustine at different dose levels (90 or 110 mg/m2).

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational antibody-cytokine fusion protein (L19 antibody fused to TNF), immunostimulatory

role_evidence.quote: among six (three L19TNF doses x two lomustine doses) combination schedules for the treatment of patient with progressing or recurrent glioblastoma

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, established GBM therapy

source_quote.quote: patients will be randomized in accordance with the following strata:

coder_notes: Lomustine dose (90 vs 110 mg/m2) differs between arms and is part of the dose-optimisation question, so per R2 it is established_therapy_experiment rather than soc_backbone; L19TNF is the only investigational agent (experimental_monotherapy). Arm-to-dose mapping is not given in the record. MGMT is a randomisation stratum (the strata list includes 'MGMT status'); inclusion also requires 'MGMT promotor status known', which is not a requirement for a particular status, so not coded as eligibility. Lead sponsor Philogen S.p.A. is a company (structured sponsor field; industry coding left to [CODE]). PK is blood only. 'Pharmacodynamic information' is mentioned without a specified measure, so target engagement = unclear.
